description: This file defines a templated class 'FrameType' within the WPEFramework::Core namespace. It provides mechanisms for managing a buffer with dynamic allocation, reading, and writing various data types, including support for serialization and deserialization. The class includes nested classes for buffer reading and writing, as well as an internal allocator class for memory management. The file appears to be part of a larger project related to data framing or packet handling, with specific focus on buffer management, serialization, and deserialization.

classes.name: FrameType
classes.description: A templated class for managing a data frame buffer with dynamic memory allocation, serialization, and deserialization capabilities.

classes.name: FrameType::Reader
classes.description: A nested class providing read access to the buffer, supporting various data extraction methods.

classes.name: FrameType::Writer
classes.description: A nested class providing write access to the buffer, supporting various data insertion methods.

classes.name: FrameType::AllocatorType
classes.description: A nested class responsible for memory allocation and management within the buffer.

methods.description: Resets the frame size to zero, effectively clearing the buffer.

methods.description: Returns the current size of the data in the frame.
